title: Object Storage: outage refund — refund amount boundary
content:
For Object Storage outage refund, the maximum refund for the concession request is the smallest of the cash credit balance, the remaining original-payment principal and the total support-adjusted service-credit ceiling. Only a provider fault incident permits a refund under this concession procedure; otherwise its permitted amount is zero.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage refund in this situation? The maximum refund for the concession request is the smallest of the cash credit balance, the remaining original-payment principal and the total support-adjusted service-credit ceiling. Only a provider fault incident permits a refund under this concession procedure; otherwise its permitted amount is zero.

## Hypothetical outage refund — refund amount boundary case

For this outage refund — refund amount boundary example, assume hypothetical cash credit balance USD 85, remaining original-payment principal USD 60 and concession ceiling USD 75. A provider-fault incident permits at most USD 60 under this boundary. With a different incident cause the permitted amount is zero.
